meaning.en: Biased views: judging people through prejudice, as if wearing tinted glasses.
meaning.zh: 比喻对人对事的偏见。

examples.zh: 别戴着有色眼镜看外地人。
examples.en: Don't view out-of-towners through tinted glasses.

examples.zh: 我们不能用有色眼镜看待残疾人。
examples.en: We mustn't look at disabled people with prejudice.

usage.en: Often 戴(着)有色眼镜看人.
usage.zh: 常说“戴着有色眼镜看人”。

meaning.en: Looking strong on the outside but weak within.
meaning.zh: 表面强大，实际空虚。

examples.zh: 别看他嗓门大，其实外强中干。
examples.en: Don't be fooled by his loud voice; he's a paper tiger.

examples.zh: 这家公司外强中干，资金链已经紧张。
examples.en: The company looks strong but is hollow, with its cash flow already strained.

story.en: Zuozhuan: 'Outwardly strong, inwardly dried up' (外强中干), of a warhorse.
story.zh: 《左传》：“外强中干，进退不可，周旋不能。”

synonyms: 练兵也，海军也，都是纸糊的老虎
一切反动派都是纸老虎
张飞卖豆腐——人硬货不硬

meaning.en: Body and head in different places: beheaded or killed.
meaning.zh: 身体和头分在两处，指被杀头。

equivalents: have one's head severed from the body

examples.zh: 叛将兵败后身首异处。
examples.en: The rebel general was beheaded after his defeat.

examples.zh: 古代许多忠臣身首异处。
examples.en: In ancient times many loyal ministers were beheaded.

meaning.en: Cold and unapproachable in manner.
meaning.zh: 形容人态度冷淡，不易接近。

examples.zh: 她对谁都冷若冰霜。
examples.en: She's icy towards everyone.

examples.zh: 他冷若冰霜的表情让大家不敢接近。
examples.en: His icy expression kept everyone away.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; also of austere dignity.
usage.zh: 可作谓语、定语，有时指端庄严肃。

antonyms: 对待同志要像春天般温暖

natural: one man can't hold up the building

meaning.en: A single timber cannot hold up a great building: one person can't bear a heavy burden alone.
meaning.zh: 一根木头难以支撑大厦，比喻一个人的力量难以支撑艰难的局面。

equivalents: one person can't prop it up alone

examples.zh: 公司危机重重，他一人独木难支。
examples.en: With the company in deep crisis, he can't hold it up alone.

examples.zh: 独木难支，我们需要更多帮手。
examples.en: One can't bear it alone; we need more help.

usage.en: Predicate; can stand alone as a remark.

synonyms: 单丝不成线，独木不成林
antonyms: 三个臭皮匠，顶个诸葛亮

natural: forget war and you court danger

meaning.en: Forgetting about war preparedness makes a country vulnerable.
meaning.zh: 忘记备战，国家一定陷入危险。

equivalents: forget defence and you invite disaster

examples.zh: 居安思危，忘战必危。
examples.en: Think of danger in times of peace; neglecting defence invites disaster.

examples.zh: 历史告诉我们，忘战必危。
examples.en: History teaches that those who forget war put themselves in danger.

story.en: Sima Fa: 'A state, however big, perishes if fond of war; the world, however calm, is in peril if it forgets war' (国虽大，好战必亡；天下虽安，忘战必危).
story.zh: 《司马法》：“国虽大，好战必亡；天下虽安，忘战必危。”

usage.en: Quoted in discussions of defence; paired with 好战必亡.
usage.zh: 多用于谈国防，常与“好战必亡”连用。

meaning.en: Unorthodox, improper methods or heterodox teachings.
meaning.zh: 不正派的方法或学说，多指不正当的门路。

examples.zh: 做生意要靠真本事，不能走旁门左道。
examples.en: In business rely on real ability, not shady shortcuts.

examples.zh: 他喜欢研究旁门左道，不务正业。
examples.en: He likes dabbling in dubious arts and neglects his proper work.

meaning.en: Pedlars and footmen: ordinary working people.
meaning.zh: 小商贩和奔走服役的人，泛指社会下层的普通劳动者。

examples.zh: 这家小店的顾客有白领，也有贩夫走卒。
examples.en: The shop's customers include office workers and ordinary labourers.

examples.zh: 从王公贵族到贩夫走卒，没有人不爱听戏。
examples.en: From nobles to common folk, everyone loved opera.

usage.en: Often contrasted with 达官贵人.

meaning.en: There is no limit to learning.
meaning.zh: 学习没有尽头，永远不会到头。

examples.zh: 学无止境，我们要活到老学到老。
examples.en: Learning has no limit; we should learn all our lives.

examples.zh: 他取得博士学位后仍然相信学无止境。
examples.en: Even with his doctorate he believes there is always more to learn.

synonyms: 怕什么真理无穷，进一寸有一寸的欢喜
师傅领进门，修行在个人
吾生也有涯，而知也无涯

meaning.en: Speaking fluently, clearly and quickly.
meaning.zh: 说话流利，清楚敏捷。

examples.zh: 这个小姑娘口齿伶俐，很讨人喜欢。
examples.en: The little girl is articulate and very likeable.

examples.zh: 主持人口齿伶俐，现场气氛很活跃。
examples.en: The host is eloquent and kept the atmosphere lively.

natural: two dragons playing with a pearl

meaning.en: Two dragons playing with a pearl: an auspicious motif in art and dragon dances.
meaning.zh: 两条龙戏弄一颗宝珠，是中国传统吉祥图案，也是舞龙的表演形式。

examples.zh: 屋檐下雕着二龙戏珠的图案。
examples.en: Under the eaves is a carving of two dragons playing with a pearl.

examples.zh: 春节庙会上表演了二龙戏珠。
examples.en: The temple fair at New Year featured a two-dragons-and-pearl dance.

usage.en: Noun phrase for a motif or performance.
usage.zh: 作名词性短语，指图案或表演。

meaning.en: To view the sky from the bottom of a well: to have a narrow outlook.
meaning.zh: 坐在井里看天，比喻眼界狭小，见识有限。

equivalents: see the world through a keyhole

examples.zh: 不出去看看，就会坐井观天。
examples.en: Without going out to see the world you'll have a narrow view.

examples.zh: 他坐井观天，以为自己最厉害。
examples.en: With his narrow horizon he thinks himself the best.

story.en: Han Yu, 'Yuan Dao': 'The one who sits in a well and looks at the sky says the sky is small' (坐井而观天，曰天小者).
story.zh: 韩愈《原道》：“坐井而观天，曰天小者，非天小也。”

synonyms: 井蛙不可以语于海者，拘于虚也；夏虫不可以语于冰者，笃于时也

meaning.en: Good fortune dropping out of the blue.
meaning.zh: 喜事从天上掉下来，形容突然遇到意外的喜事。

examples.zh: 中了大奖，他简直喜从天降。
examples.en: Winning the jackpot felt like a gift from heaven.

examples.zh: 这个消息让全家喜从天降。
examples.en: The news was a delightful surprise to the whole family.

meaning.en: A carp leaping the Dragon Gate: a sudden rise to success, as in passing the imperial exams.
meaning.zh: 鲤鱼跳过龙门就变成龙，比喻科举高中或地位突然升高。

equivalents: leap up the ladder of success

examples.zh: 他考上名牌大学，算是鱼跃龙门。
examples.en: Getting into a top university was his leap to success.

examples.zh: 很多人梦想着鱼跃龙门，改变命运。
examples.en: Many dream of a big leap to change their fate.

story.en: Book of the Later Han: those received by Li Ying were said to have 'passed the Dragon Gate' (登龙门).
story.zh: 《后汉书》载：士有被其容接者，名为登龙门。

usage.zh: 作谓语或名词，带希望色彩。

meaning.en: Speaking with a hidden meaning behind the words.
meaning.zh: 话中另有含义，别有所指。

equivalents: there's more than meets the ear

examples.zh: 她这话话里有话，大家都听出来了。
examples.en: There was more to what she said, and everyone caught it.

examples.zh: 他话里有话，是在暗示我早点走。
examples.en: He's hinting something; he's telling me to leave early.

meaning.en: Not understanding clearly or thoroughly.
meaning.zh: 了解得不太清楚。

examples.zh: 他对这方面的规定不甚了了。
examples.en: He is hazy about the rules in this area.

examples.zh: 对于这件事的内情，我不甚了了。
examples.en: I'm not very clear on the inside story of this affair.

usage.en: Predicate; formal. Note 了 is liǎo.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语。“了”读 liǎo。

meaning.en: Like the autumn wind sweeping away dead leaves: a force that clears all before it.
meaning.zh: 像秋风扫落叶一样，比喻强大的力量迅速扫除衰败的事物。

examples.zh: 大军如秋风扫落叶，一路攻下数城。
examples.en: The army swept through, taking city after city like autumn wind sweeping leaves.

examples.zh: 他把盘子里的菜吃得秋风扫落叶一样干净。
examples.en: He cleared the dishes as swiftly as an autumn wind clears leaves.

meaning.en: To find a little comfort for oneself.
meaning.zh: 姑且用来安慰自己。

examples.zh: 虽然没拿到名次，但学到了不少，聊以自慰。
examples.en: I didn't place, but I learned a lot, which is some comfort.

examples.zh: 他写诗聊以自慰。
examples.en: He wrote poetry as a consolation to himself.

usage.en: Predicate; formal; often 聊以自慰 after 虽然….

meaning.en: When things go wrong, look for the cause in oneself.
meaning.zh: 遇到问题，首先从自己身上找原因。

examples.zh: 事情没做成，要先反求诸己。
examples.en: When things fail, first look to yourself.

examples.zh: 君子反求诸己，小人反求诸人。
examples.en: The gentleman seeks the cause in himself, the petty man in others.

story.en: Mencius: 'If you act and do not succeed, look within yourself for the cause' (行有不得者，皆反求诸己).
story.zh: 《孟子》：“行有不得者，皆反求诸己，其身正而天下归之。”

synonyms: 君子求诸己，小人求诸人

natural: lure the tiger from its mountain

meaning.en: To lure an opponent away from his stronghold, then strike.
meaning.zh: 设法引诱对方离开原来的地方，以便乘机行动。

examples.zh: 他们用调虎离山之计，把守卫引开了。
examples.en: They used the lure-the-tiger trick and drew the guards away.

examples.zh: 这是调虎离山，别上当。
examples.en: It's a decoy; don't fall for it.

story.en: The fifteenth of the Thirty-Six Stratagems, 'Lure the tiger down from the mountain'.
story.zh: 《三十六计》第十五计：“待天以困之，用人以诱之，往蹇来连。”

date.zh: 明清之际 · 17世纪（成书年代不详）

usage.en: Often 使/用调虎离山之计.

meaning.en: Blood and flesh flying in all directions: a scene of bloody carnage.
meaning.zh: 形容战斗或爆炸场面十分惨烈。

examples.zh: 爆炸现场血肉横飞，惨不忍睹。
examples.en: The explosion scene was a bloody horror to behold.

examples.zh: 这部电影里战争场面血肉横飞。
examples.en: The war scenes in the film are full of gore.

meaning.en: Full of awe-inspiring righteousness.
meaning.zh: 形容人有浩然正气，令人敬畏。

examples.zh: 他面对威胁，依然正气凛然。
examples.en: Faced with threats he remained upright and commanding.

examples.zh: 法官正气凛然地宣读了判决。
examples.en: The judge read the verdict with stern righteousness.

literal: take off · armour · return to · fields
natural: retire from the army to farm

meaning.en: To lay down arms and return to farming; to retire from military service.
meaning.zh: 脱下铠甲回乡种田，指军人退伍还乡。

examples.zh: 战争结束后，许多老兵解甲归田。
examples.en: After the war many veterans returned to civilian life.

examples.zh: 他解甲归田，在家乡种起了果树。
examples.en: He hung up his uniform and took up orchard farming back home.

usage.en: Predicate; also of leaving a career.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，也比喻退出职场。
